scope.phy_mode: VHT20 2x2 MIMO (MCS 7/8 LOS + mixed edge SNR)

CONFIRMED_ON_BENCH: Stage 7.2: ATF (airtime_flags=3) + AQL (1500/3000 us) cuts loaded p50 RTT by 4.06x (51.35 -> 12.65 ms) and TCP retransmits by 10x (158 -> 16).
Stage 7.3: RTS/CTS = 256B under 3-station hidden-node UL contention boosts total sector UL goodput by +18.5% (150.40 -> 178.17 Mbps) and weak NLOS CPE goodput by 3.07x (1.97 -> 6.03 Mbps).
Stage 7.4: WMM AC_VO DiffServ Deficit Bypass (DSCP EF -> Deficit: VO +256 us) bypasses negative Deficit: BE (-67,099 us), cutting weak-station p50 RTT by 21.0x (143.00 -> 6.80 ms).
Stage 12 R60-R80: 11-point declared distance / coverage-class grid (100 m .. 15,000 m, class 0..33) verified on physical QCA988x bench with <2% goodput loss and 2.1x-3.0x p95 RTT reduction vs stock.
CONFIRMED_BY_STATIC_RE: Stage 10-12: Stock airOS 8 TDMA uses ubnt_poll_host.ko + umac.ko + athwlan_AR9888v2_ptmp_ap_bin / ptmp_sta_bin with addradio mode 1 autonomous TX suppression, 30s missing-poll timer (.text+0x7c08), INFOTXQ, and NO-TX-DETECT.
INFERRED_MODELED: Coupled Bianchi + hidden-node RTS vulnerability window T_vuln(d) = 36 + 6.671*d_km us and coverage-class slot inflation sigma(d) = 9 + 3*c(d) us vs. TDMA polling turnaround overhead across N = 4..32 CPEs and d = 1..14 km.

spec.title: Regime 3: Worst-Case Saturated Full Hidden-Node Uplink (alpha_HN=1.0, rho_UL=1.0)
spec.description: All N CPEs are simultaneously backlogged with continuous uplink traffic and 100% of CPE pairs are mutually hidden (cannot hear peer RTS frames, only the AP's broadcast CTS).

spec.title: Regime 2: Typical 90-120 deg WISP Sector with Partial Clutter + AQL/TSQ Pacing (alpha_HN=0.50, rho_UL=0.35)
spec.description: Representative outdoor 90-120 deg PtMP sector where 50% of CPE pairs are mutually hidden by terrain/foliage/azimuth and Cooperative CPE Asymmetric AQL (2100/4200 us) + TCP TSQ (128 KB) pace uplink bursts to 35% simultaneous contention.

spec.title: Regime 1: Narrow/LOS Sector or Light Uplink Contention (alpha_HN=0.15, rho_UL=0.25)
spec.description: Narrow-beamwidth (30-60 deg horn/sector) or co-visible LOS cluster where 85% of CPE pairs hear each other's RTS preamble and AQL/TSQ keeps simultaneous uplink burst concurrency at 25%.
